cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I only finished one painting for our exhibition. Tell me I've done enough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll spread mine out. Nobody will notice the gap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I need to know I've contributed, not that you can hide where I haven't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours belongs in the middle. It's the one people will see first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce me as the other painter. No 'despite everything'. I want to hear that I belong here.

mechanism: A copies an exhibition mark as a sufficiency signal, covers its actual meaning, and asks B to affirm contribution rather than hide inadequacy.
confusable: D100 reassurance of enough differs from D76 blessing for a choice.
comparison: One painting contribution versus surviving public speech.
seedUse: Keep B central-placement offer making public equal recognition possible.
